problems.quote: Text, Image, Click are human ratings (7-point scale) with standard errors clustered at the ad level.
problems.note: The paper explicitly clusters standard errors by ad. Its uncertainty therefore treats ads (outputs) as independent, allowing dependence among the ratings of each ad. Under the extraction-spec definition of se_basis, this is output. The observation unit remains rating, and n_units=45803 correctly counts rating observations. Ad clustering does not account for multiple ads from the same creator, so this correction does not establish participant-level precision.

summary: Read the entire 116133-character markdown, including Appendices A-L, and checked all 13 estimates against the cited PDF pages and relevant methods. All recorded coefficients, standard errors, significance bounds, the reported productivity percentage, and counts match the paper and their stated analyses. Three se_basis codes require correction from rating to output because the human-rating models cluster by ad. The other requested outcome and design codes are supported. No missing eligible outcome or contrast was found under extraction rules 4-6; the omitted field models adjust for post-treatment ad ratings and/or campaign spend. Unreported means, SDs, and contributing-creator counts are appropriately left null.
